name: Ascension
audio: deep drums, a low earthen rumble, bone chimes and a hawk's cry; no speech
world: The grove is alive: ancestral fires flicker, spirit lights drift between the totems, wind chimes ring, feathers and dust swirl and warm light shifts through the trees.

actions.beat: The ancestral fires between the standing stones leap high and the carved faces of the totem poles begin to glow.
{{She}} plants the staff and raises {{her}} free arm high as glowing spirits of beasts rise from the stones and circle {{her}}, {{her}} hair and fringe lifting.
Terrador rises among the totems behind {{her}} and lowers its great head as the spirits settle into a slow ring, and {{she}} turns a fierce, proud look to the camera.

notes: The Holo edition in motion: her ascended moment with the dragon and the world moving around her.
